reels.title: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper offers a perfect hardware-efficiency breakthrough. Visualizing a 'recurrent' transformer block—where information travels through the same physical gates at different depths—is ideal for 3b1b-style fluid, repeating animation cycles that demonstrate how to achieve the same result with fewer compute resources.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could build a super-intelligent robot brain using only one single piece of hardware that 'thinks' in circles?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A single specialized worker who practices a task repeatedly to get faster and deeper insights, rather than hiring an entire assembly line.
